def analyze_attention_patterns(attention_weights, tokens, n_heads):
    """Analyze and summarize attention patterns."""
    seq_len = len(tokens)
    analysis = {}

    for head in range(n_heads):
        head_weights = attention_weights[0, head, :, :]  # (seq_len, seq_len)

        # TODO: Compute attention entropy per token (measure of focus)
        # Higher entropy = more diffuse attention
        entropy = -np.sum(head_weights * np.log(head_weights + 1e-10), axis=-1)

        # TODO: Find most attended-to token for each position
        most_attended = np.argmax(head_weights, axis=-1)

        # TODO: Compute self-attention ratio (diagonal vs off-diagonal)
        diagonal = np.trace(head_weights) / seq_len
        off_diagonal = 1.0 - diagonal

        analysis[f"head_{head}"] = {
            "mean_entropy": float(np.mean(entropy)),
            "self_attention_ratio": float(diagonal),
            "most_attended_pairs": [
                (tokens[i], tokens[most_attended[i]])
                for i in range(seq_len)
            ]
        }

    return analysis


def compute_attention_flow(attention_weights, layer_weights, source_token_idx, target_token_idx):
    """Compute attention flow from source to target token across layers."""
    n_layers = len(layer_weights)
    flow_per_layer = []

    for layer in range(n_layers):
        # TODO: Extract attention weight from source to target
        # attention_weights shape: (batch, heads, seq, seq)
        attn = layer_weights[layer]
        flow = np.mean(attn[0, :, source_token_idx, target_token_idx])
        flow_per_layer.append(float(flow))

    return flow_per_layer


if __name__ == "__main__":
    np.random.seed(42)
    batch_size = 1
    seq_len = 8
    d_model = 64
    n_heads = 4

    attention = MultiHeadAttention(d_model, n_heads)
    x = np.random.randn(batch_size, seq_len, d_model)

    output, attn_weights = attention.forward(x)
    print(f"Output shape: {output.shape}")
    print(f"Attention shape: {attn_weights.shape}")

    tokens = ["The", "cat", "sat", "on", "the", "mat", "happily", "."]
    analysis = analyze_attention_patterns(attn_weights, tokens, n_heads)
    for head, info in analysis.items():
        print(f"{head}: entropy={info['mean_entropy']:.3f}, self-attn={info['self_attention_ratio']:.3f}")
